title: 3037000500 * 3037000500 wraps around to -9223372036709301616

source.quote: there is an overflow condition, but there is no overflow error and the result is the least significant representable digits
source.supports: integer sum, subtraction and multiplication wrap around on overflow instead of failing

derivation: Both operands are integers, so the product is an integer. 3037000500 squared is 9223372037000250000, which is above 2^63 - 1 = 9223372036854775807. There is no overflow error; the result is the low 64 bits: 9223372037000250000 - 2^64 = -9223372036709301616.
notes: If multiplication overflow were an error the query would fail; if it promoted to a decimal number the result would be the double 9.22337203700025E+18.
